headlines.title: Judge unseals documents related to search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home
headlines.description: Some of the unsealed court filings make clear the Trump administration believes violations of the law took place as far back as 1980.

headlines.title: Trump to award Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom, the nation’s highest civilian honor
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will award the Presidential Medal of Freedom on Tuesday to Rudy Giuliani, the controversial former mayor of New York City and ally to the president.

headlines.title: Blanche assures he would have told Trump about any crimes Jensen Huang committed
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche told reporters that he "certainly" would have told President Trump if the Department of Justice was investigating Jensen Huang for committing any crimes before his reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO.

headlines.title: Federal Court Clears Way for Iowa Lead Ammunition Detonation
headlines.description: The U.S. Army is moving forward with a controversial plan to detonate nearly five tons of hazardous bomb-making chemicals at an ammunition plant in Iowa after a federal court ruled cleared the way late Monday. The blast, which is set for Wednesday, is prompting fears from residents that it will trigger a toxic cloud of dust. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Faces Backlash Over Role in Nvidia CEO’s Reinstatement
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is facing mounting bipartisan criticism and questions over his role in helping to get Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reinstated less than two weeks after his ouster following his admitted affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Trump, who is a significant Nvidia shareholder, said he told Nvidia’s board that Huang is not a security risk. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Trump uses backdrop of DOJ to bash Gavin Newsom on death row commutations
headlines.description: President Donald Trump gave his speech at the Justice Department headquarters — a rarity for a president — and invited victims’ family members to speak onstage.

headlines.title: How will voters respond to divided government?: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur digs into how an electorate that is hungry for results may collide withe the realities of divided government.

headlines.title: Congress reacts with anger and skepticism about Jensen Huang reinstatement
headlines.description: Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle vowed to press ahead with investigations into the once-again Nvidia CEO, who’s scheduled to meet with them next week.

headlines.title: Appeals court gives Trump another chance to move his hush money conviction case to a federal venue
headlines.description: The 2nd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals found a federal judge “erred” when he ruled that President Donald Trump had waited too long to raise his immunity defense.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez to resign after Ethics Committee finds he engaged in sexual misconduct
headlines.description: Gomez — who lost his re-election bid this month — said that while he cooperated with the investigation, he had “strong disagreements” with the committee’s conclusions.

headlines.title: Trump says he spoke ‘directly and indirectly’ with Nvidia’s board about reinstating Jensen Huang
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said he spoke with Nvidia’s board members about reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, telling CNBC on Monday morning that he sought to provide assurances to address their concerns about national security.
